visual.title: Sphere label colors exceed expected brightness range
visual.description: The sphere labels (Force, Matter, etc.) use bright colors at 70-90% luminance in UI chrome rather than concentrated as thin threads. Force: rgb(255,107,107)=~60%L, Energy: rgb(255,228,77)=~84%L, Life: rgb(51,255,119)=~73%L.
visual.evidence: Computed colors from CosmologyPanel sphere labels
visual.suggestedFix: Use muted sphere colors for label text, bright only for icon/indicator elements.

visual.title: World hex tile cream/gold colors exceed 40% brightness ceiling
visual.description: World gen hex tiles include #e3d08a (cream/gold fill) at ~55% brightness. STYLE.md prescribes 10-40% for world surfaces.
visual.evidence: SVG hex fill #e3d08a (~55% L) vs threshold 40%
visual.location: HexMap.tsx, hexGeneration.ts - hex fill color assignment
visual.suggestedFix: Reduce light hex colors to max 40% lightness.

visual.title: Archetype card backgrounds slightly bright for dark aesthetic
visual.description: Cards use rgba(68,60,48,0.8) ~26%L. Within spec but warm brown tone could be darker to strengthen dark aesthetic.

visual.title: Unicode symbols used instead of colored sphere icons
visual.description: Sphere symbols (✦,⬡,⊙,∿,◉,⟡,◈,◆) rendered as plain text with inherited colors instead of dedicated SVG with sphere-specific colors.
visual.evidence: Unicode glyphs with inherited text color vs STYLE.md sphere hex colors
visual.suggestedFix: Replace with SVG icon fills matching canonical sphere colors.

visual.title: Unexplored hex background minimally contrasts with page background
visual.description: Unexplored hexes #1e1b2e (~10%L) hard to discern from background.

visual.title: Data display monospace font consistency needs verification
visual.description: STYLE.md specifies monospace for data, serif for narrative. Hard to confirm consistently from CSS alone.
visual.evidence: Requires font-family property audit across all data-display elements
visual.suggestedFix: Audit all data elements for monospace font-family.

visual.title: Button backgrounds slightly brighter than oklch spec
visual.description: Buttons use rgb(34,34,40) ~13%L vs spec oklch(0.21-0.24) ~8-12%L.

visual.title: World gen sidebar brightness exceeds dark chrome spec
visual.description: CosmologyPanel background oklch(0.268,...) ~27%L vs spec oklch(0.21-0.24) ~8-12%L.
visual.suggestedFix: Darken to oklch(0.22,...) or document intentional deviation.

visual.title: Hex info panel hover state not audited
visual.description: InfoPanel for hex hover details not captured — requires hover interaction. Colors unverified.
visual.evidence: No hover data captured during sweep
visual.suggestedFix: Follow-up audit: hover over hexes to capture InfoPanel colors.

visual.title: Sphere percentage labels very bright at ~92%L
visual.description: Percentage text oklch(0.924,...) ~92%L creates strong contrast that may be visually noisy.

info-arch.title: Narrative log 60% template repetition ('reshaping the fate of the realm')
info-arch.description: 18 of 30 entries use 'acted with [adjective] purpose, reshaping the fate of the realm' pattern. Monotonous despite sophisticated event systems.
info-arch.suggestedFix: Expand prose templates with varied sentence structures.

info-arch.title: Redundant Cycle/Year display in time section
info-arch.description: Both 'Cycle 1' and 'Year 1' shown separately. Unclear hierarchy.
info-arch.evidence: Two separate P tags for Cycle and Year
info-arch.suggestedFix: Consolidate to single line or remove Cycle.

info-arch.title: Action Drawer 78% disabled actions create visual clutter
info-arch.description: 7 of 9 actions disabled at early game. Creates 'broken UI' feel with prominent error text.
info-arch.evidence: 9 actions, 2 enabled (Scry, Dream), 7 disabled with explanatory text
info-arch.suggestedFix: Progressive disclosure: show enabled first, collapsible locked section.

info-arch.title: Retinue Panel sparse until agent selected
info-arch.description: Only 3 names + locations before selection. Density jumps 150% on drill-down.
info-arch.suggestedFix: Add micro-indicators: trait tags, essence icons, status indicators.

info-arch.title: Rival god actions use identical narrative structure
info-arch.description: 3 rival actions back-to-back with identical [Rival] [action] [verbose phrase] pattern. Zero faction voice differentiation.
info-arch.evidence: Entries 21-23: Veiled Prophet, Burning Oracle, Bone Tyrant all same grammar
info-arch.suggestedFix: Vary narrative voice by rival faction archetype.

info-arch.title: Divine Essence panel lacks H3 subheading
info-arch.description: H2 'Divine Essence' → sphere list with no H3 subheading. Hierarchy skips a level.
info-arch.evidence: H2 → generic divs with no H3
info-arch.suggestedFix: Add H3 'Sphere Affinities' or restructure heading levels.

info-arch.title: Narrative log and action drawer overlap in narrow viewports
info-arch.description: No responsive collapse strategy. Action drawer's 9 buttons require ~800px. Narrative log cut off.
info-arch.evidence: Action drawer 9 × ~160px width. No breakpoint collapse.
info-arch.suggestedFix: Responsive breakpoints: compact log and modal drawer at <1400px.

info-arch.title: Generic 'agent failed encounter' messages lack context
info-arch.description: 'An agent failed their encounter step' appears 2x with no agent name, reason, or impact.
info-arch.suggestedFix: Include agent name + reason or suppress low-info failures.

interaction.title: Mandate popover blocked by aria-hidden overlay, only Escape closes
interaction.description: Modal overlay (z-index 40) blocks pointer events on mandate popover content. Only Escape key works.
interaction.evidence: div aria-hidden intercepts pointer events on popover
interaction.suggestedFix: Fix z-index layering or make overlay pointer-events: none for popovers.

interaction.title: Move mode shows no visual feedback of valid hex targets
interaction.description: Move button activates (red highlight, tooltip) but hex map shows no valid destination indicators.
interaction.evidence: Active Move button visible but no map highlighting
interaction.suggestedFix: Highlight valid destination hexes with glow/color when move mode active.

interaction.title: Dream action requires extra Agenda Picker step, inconsistent with other actions
interaction.description: Dream → AgendaPicker → InterventionConfirm is two-step vs one-step for other actions.
interaction.evidence: Dream card opens AgendaPicker before confirm; other actions skip to confirm
interaction.suggestedFix: Document two-step pattern or add 'Select variant' label on Dream card.

interaction.title: Actions button switches selected agent to first retinue member
interaction.description: With Mirael selected, clicking Actions opens drawer for Brynn (first retinue member) instead.
interaction.evidence: Agent selection state lost on Actions button click
interaction.suggestedFix: Show actions for currently selected agent, or clarify button scope.

interaction.title: Hex map clicks don't open zoom view; only agent zoom buttons work
interaction.description: Direct hex tile clicks on game map don't trigger HexZoomView. Zoom only accessible via retinue panel zoom buttons.
interaction.evidence: Clicks at hex positions (600,700) and (700,500) — no response
interaction.suggestedFix: Verify hex click handlers are registered. Add click-to-zoom on visible hexes.

react-code.title: GameView inline event handlers without useCallback
react-code.description: Event handlers created inline in JSX without useCallback cause unnecessary re-renders of child components.
react-code.evidence: Inline arrow functions in GameView JSX props
react-code.suggestedFix: Wrap handlers in useCallback with appropriate dependency arrays.

react-code.title: Inline style objects without extraction to constants
react-code.description: Inline gradient and magic values hardcoded in styles violate tunability priority #1.
react-code.suggestedFix: Extract to named constants or CSS variables.

react-code.title: Missing null safety checks on agent data access
react-code.description: AgentInfoCard accesses nested properties without null guards, violating fail-soft priority #4.
react-code.evidence: Direct property access on potentially undefined agent data
react-code.suggestedFix: Add optional chaining and fallback empty state rendering.

react-code.title: ActionDrawer close button lacks keyboard support
react-code.description: Close button handler only responds to click, not Enter/Space keyboard events.
react-code.suggestedFix: Add role='button' tabIndex={0} onKeyDown handler for Enter/Space.

react-code.title: HexZoomView polygon vertex array recreated every render
react-code.description: Hex polygon vertex calculations recreated on each render without memoization.
react-code.evidence: Vertex array created inline in render

react-code.title: HexZoomView SVG text elements lack semantic roles
react-code.description: Interactive SVG text elements missing role and aria attributes for screen readers.
react-code.evidence: SVG text elements without role='button' or aria-label
react-code.suggestedFix: Add role='button' aria-label to interactive SVG elements.

react-code.title: EncounterLog missing null safety on encounter data
react-code.description: Encounter data access without null guards could crash on missing encounters.
react-code.evidence: Direct property access on encounter objects
react-code.suggestedFix: Add optional chaining and empty state rendering.

react-code.title: Tooltip portal lacks focus management
react-code.description: Tooltip portal renders outside DOM hierarchy without managing focus trapping or announcement.
react-code.evidence: Portal rendering without aria-live or focus management
react-code.suggestedFix: Add aria-live='polite' to tooltip portal container.

react-code.title: Tooltip regex with mutable lastIndex causes parse failures
react-code.description: Global regex flag causes lastIndex state mutation between renders, leading to intermittent parse failures.
react-code.evidence: Regex with /g flag used across renders without resetting lastIndex
react-code.suggestedFix: Remove /g flag or reset lastIndex before each use.

react-code.title: DebugPanel tab button style function creates objects every render
react-code.description: Tab button style computation creates new objects on every render cycle.
react-code.evidence: Style function called inline in render without memoization
react-code.suggestedFix: Memoize style objects or extract to CSS classes.

react-code.title: DebugPanel direct DOM style mutations bypass React
react-code.description: Direct element.style mutations instead of React state cause potential inconsistencies.
react-code.suggestedFix: Use React state/refs for style changes.

react-code.title: AgentProfileModal unsafe property access without null checks
react-code.description: Profile data access on optional fields without null guards could crash the modal.
react-code.evidence: Direct property access on potentially undefined nested objects
react-code.suggestedFix: Add optional chaining (?.) and fallback values.

react-code.title: LocationView prose generation not fully memoized
react-code.description: Prose generation triggered on every render instead of memoized by location ID.
react-code.evidence: Prose computation in render path without useMemo
react-code.suggestedFix: Wrap prose generation in useMemo keyed on location ID.

react-code.title: ScryOverlay direct DOM style mutations
react-code.description: Direct DOM manipulations bypass React reconciliation.
react-code.suggestedFix: Use React state/refs for style changes.

react-code.title: NarrativeLog direct DOM style mutations
react-code.description: Direct DOM manipulations for scroll behavior bypass React.
react-code.suggestedFix: Use useRef + scrollIntoView or CSS scroll-behavior.

react-code.title: RetinuePanel cleanup leak in event listener
react-code.description: Event listener added without proper cleanup in useEffect return.
react-code.evidence: addEventListener without corresponding removeEventListener in cleanup
react-code.suggestedFix: Return cleanup function from useEffect that removes event listener.
